PR: remove Upbound code from code base [closed]
### Description of your changes

#### Removal of Upbound code

This PR removes all Upbound related code from the Crossplane code base. This is intended to continue improving the project's vendor neutrality positioning in accordance with CNCF guidelines.

A lot of this code came from the fact that `xpkg.upbound.io` was the default registry for a long time and a good experience was built around supporting it smoothly, but that was changed in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6296 in response to feedback

on our graduation proposal during due diligence. The Upbound specific code (mostly around `xpkg.upbound.io` auth) is no longer needed anyways, as the standard `docker/login-action` workflow now works well too, as shown in https://github.com/jbw976/function-xbuckets/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L174-L192.

So, the biggest change that is functional in nature is completely removing the Upbound modules completely from https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/tree/main/internal/xpkg/upbound.
